cases.name: Tracy L. Hill Krueger
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "Her hobbies included spending time with her girls, hiking in the mountains, fishing, swimming, riding Harleys and hanging out with friends and family to watch Packers games.

Tracy fell in love with waitressing at a very young age because of her love for people and her wanting to put a smile on everyone’s face. She was very good at her job and did it with her whole heart. She waitressed at Cimarolli’s supper club for several years, and at the Golden Cup 2. Tracy then moved to Tennessee and worked at Aunt Bea’s for a few years. When she moved backed to Portage, she returned to work at the Golden Cup 2."
